summary: Evolus, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment to a license, supply, and distribution agreement with Symatese Aesthetics S.A.S. The amendment expands Evolus Europe's exclusive commercialization rights for Estyme hyaluronic acid gels to Canada, Australia, and New Zealand. Consideration includes €920,000 upfront and up to €1.38 million upon regulatory approvals; Symatese handles regulatory activities. The initial term is 15 years per territory with automatic five-year renewals. This is a routine business development agreement, not a special situation.
